records.literal_gloss: From beyond [the] rivers of Cush my worshipers, [the] daughter of my scattered ones, will bring my offering.

en.L: From beyond the rivers of Cush \q {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} worshipers, the daughter of {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} scattered ones, \q will bring {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} offering.
en.B: From beyond the rivers of Cush \q those who pray to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} scattered people, \q will bring {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} offerings.
en.R: People who worship {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} will come from beyond the rivers of Cush, south of Egypt. \q My people who were scattered \q will bring gifts to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.

fr.L: D’au-delà des fleuves de Koush, \q {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} adorateurs, la fille de {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} dispersés, \q apporteront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} offrande.
fr.B: D’au-delà des fleuves de Koush, \q ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} prient, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple dispersé, \q {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apporteront des offrandes.
fr.R: Des gens qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}adorent viendront d’au-delà des fleuves de Koush, au sud de l’Égypte. \q Mon peuple qui avait été dispersé \q {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}apportera des cadeaux.

es.L: Desde más allá de los ríos de Cus \q {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} adoradores, la hija de {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} dispersos, \q traerán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ofrenda.
es.B: Desde más allá de los ríos de Cus, \q los que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} invocan, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo disperso, \q {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traerán ofrendas.
es.R: Desde más allá de los ríos de Cus, al sur de Egipto, vendrá gente que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} adora. \q Mi pueblo que fue dispersado \q {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} traerá regalos.

sw.L: Kutoka ng'ambo ya mito ya Kushi \q waabudu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, binti wa waliotawanyika {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wataleta sadaka {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: Kutoka ng'ambo ya mito ya Kushi \q wale wanaoniomba, watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waliotawanyika, \q wataniletea sadaka.
sw.R: Watu wanaoniabudu watakuja kutoka ng'ambo ya mito ya Kushi, kusini mwa Misri. \q Watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} waliotawanyika \q wataniletea zawadi.

vi.L: Từ bên kia các sông của Cút, \q những kẻ thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, con gái của những kẻ tản lạc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q sẽ đem lễ vật của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đến.
vi.B: Từ bên kia các sông xứ Cút, \q những kẻ cầu khẩn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bị tản lạc, \q sẽ đem lễ vật đến dâng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Những người thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đến từ bên kia các sông xứ Cút, ở phía nam Ai Cập. \q Dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã bị tản lạc \q sẽ đem lễ vật đến dâng cho {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 구스의 강들 건너편에서 \q 나를 섬기는 자들, 내가 흩은 자들의 딸이 \q 나에게 바칠 예물을 가져올 것이다.
ko.B: 구스의 강들 건너편에서 \q 나에게 기도하는 자들, 곧 흩어졌던 내 백성이 \q 나에게 예물을 가져올 것이다.
ko.R: 이집트 남쪽 구스의 강들 건너편에서 나를 예배하는 사람들이 올 것이다. \q 흩어졌던 내 백성이 \q 나에게 예물을 가져올 것이다.

decisions.choice: the rivers of Cush: the upper Nile, the farthest south
decisions.reason: Cush lay south of Egypt along the Nile and its branches (2:12; Isaiah 18:1). The farthest land known to the south will send worshipers. |

decisions.choice: my worshipers, the daughter of my scattered ones: either scattered Israelites or the peoples of verse 9
decisions.reason: The first word is from the verb "pray, plead", so it means those who pray to the LORD. "The daughter of my scattered ones" may be the LORD's people scattered in exile, brought home by the nations (Isaiah 11:11-12; 66:20), or the peoples of verse 9 themselves, coming with gifts (Isaiah 18:7). The text leaves it open, and the wording keeps both readings possible.

decisions.choice: my offering: a gift brought to the LORD
decisions.reason: The word is used for the grain offering and for tribute brought to a king (Malachi 1:11; Psalm 72:10). |

decisions.choice: those who pray to me, my scattered people (B), My people who were scattered (R); offerings (B), gifts (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "those who pray to me" for "my worshipers" (m2). Balanced and Readable say "people" for the poetic "daughter", as "Daughter Zion" stands for the people of Zion. Readable adds where Cush was, as at 2:12. |

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹ֤א תֵב֨וֹשִׁי֙ מִכֹּ֣ל עֲלִילֹתַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּשַׁ֖עַתְּ בִּ֑י כִּי־אָ֣ז׀אָסִ֣יר מִקִּרְבֵּ֗ךְ עַלִּיזֵי֙ גַּאֲוָתֵ֔ךְ וְלֹֽא־תוֹסִ֧פִי לְגָבְהָ֛ה ע֖וֹד בְּהַ֥ר קָדְשִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: In that day you will not be ashamed because of all your deeds by which you have transgressed against me; for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exulting [ones], and you will not again be haughty on my holy mountain.

en.L: In that day you will not be put to shame for all your deeds \q by which you transgressed against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q for then I will remove from your midst your proudly exulting ones, \q and you will no longer be haughty on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain.
en.B: On that day you will not be put to shame for all the deeds \q by which you rebelled against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, \q for then I will take away from among you those who proudly exult, \q and never again will you be haughty on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain.
en.R: At that time you will not be ashamed of all the wrong things \q you did when you sinned against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I will take away from among you the people who are proud and boast. \q You will never again be proud on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy mountain.

fr.L: En ce jour-là tu ne seras pas couverte de honte pour toutes tes actions \q par lesquelles tu as transgressé contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} ; \q car alors j’ôterai du milieu de toi ceux qui exultent avec orgueil, \q et tu ne seras plus hautaine sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte.
fr.B: Ce jour-là, tu n’auras plus à rougir de toutes les actions \q par lesquelles tu t’es révoltée contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, \q car alors j’enlèverai du milieu de toi ceux qui se vantent avec orgueil, \q et jamais plus tu ne seras hautaine sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, tu n’auras plus honte de tout le mal \q que tu as fait quand tu as péché contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q J’enlèverai du milieu de toi les gens orgueilleux qui se vantent. \q Tu ne seras plus jamais orgueilleuse sur {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} montagne sainte.

es.L: En aquel día no serás avergonzada por todas tus obras \q con las que te rebelaste contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}; \q porque entonces quitaré de en medio de ti a tus orgullosos jactanciosos, \q y nunca más te ensoberbecerás en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte.
es.B: Aquel día no serás avergonzada por todas las obras \q con las que te rebelaste contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, \q porque entonces quitaré de en medio de ti a los que se jactan con orgullo, \q y nunca más serás altiva en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte.
es.R: En ese tiempo no tendrás que avergonzarte de todo el mal \q que hiciste cuando pecaste contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q Quitaré de en medio de ti a la gente orgullosa y jactanciosa. \q Nunca más serás orgullosa en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo monte.

sw.L: Katika siku ile hutaaibishwa kwa ajili ya matendo yako yote \q ambayo kwayo uliniasi {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}; \q kwa maana hapo nitawaondoa katikati yako wale wanaoshangilia kwa kiburi, \q wala hutajivuna tena katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu.
sw.B: Siku hiyo hutaaibishwa kwa ajili ya matendo yako yote \q ambayo kwayo uliniasi, \q kwa maana hapo nitawaondoa kati yako wale wanaojigamba kwa kiburi, \q wala hutajivuna tena kamwe katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu.
sw.R: Wakati huo hutaona aibu kwa ajili ya mabaya yote \q uliyoyatenda ulipofanya dhambi dhidi yangu. \q Nitawaondoa kati yako watu wenye kiburi na wanaojisifu. \q Hutajivuna tena kamwe katika mlima {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} mtakatifu.

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy ngươi sẽ không bị hổ thẹn vì mọi việc làm của ngươi, \q là những việc ngươi đã vi phạm nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q vì bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất khỏi giữa ngươi những kẻ hớn hở kiêu căng của ngươi, \q và ngươi sẽ không còn kiêu ngạo trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa.
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy con sẽ không còn bị hổ thẹn vì mọi việc làm \q mà con đã phản nghịch {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q vì bấy giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cất khỏi giữa con những kẻ kiêu căng hớn hở, \q và con sẽ không bao giờ còn kiêu ngạo trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy con sẽ không phải xấu hổ vì mọi điều sai trái \q con đã làm khi phạm tội nghịch cùng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Ta sẽ cất bỏ khỏi giữa con những kẻ kiêu ngạo và khoe khoang. \q Con sẽ không bao giờ còn kiêu ngạo trên núi thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa.

ko.L: 그날에 너는 나를 거슬러 반역한 \q 너의 모든 행위 때문에 수치를 당하지 않을 것이다. \q 그때에 내가 네 가운데서 교만하여 뽐내는 자들을 없애 버릴 것이니, \q 네가 다시는 내 거룩한 산에서 거만하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그날에 너는 나를 거슬러 반역한 \q 모든 행위 때문에 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것이다. \q 그때에 내가 너희 가운데서 교만하여 뽐내는 자들을 없애 버리겠다. \q 네가 다시는 내 거룩한 산에서 거만하게 굴지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에 너는 나에게 죄를 짓고 \q 저지른 그 모든 잘못 때문에 부끄러워하지 않을 것이다. \q 내가 너희 가운데서 교만하고 잘난 체하는 사람들을 없애 버리겠다. \q 너희는 다시는 내 거룩한 산에서 교만하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: you will not be put to shame: the city is now addressed with promise
decisions.reason: "You" is Jerusalem, Daughter Zion, as in verses 14-20. She will no longer be disgraced by her past, because the LORD has dealt with it (verse 15). |

decisions.choice: your proudly exulting ones: those who boast in their pride
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used in Isaiah 13:3 for the LORD's warriors who exult. Here it means the arrogant in Jerusalem, the leaders of verses 3-4, who will be removed. |

decisions.choice: my holy mountain: Zion, where the temple stood
decisions.reason: The temple mount in Jerusalem (Isaiah 2:2-3; Joel 2:1). Pride had no place there. |

decisions.choice: transgressed (L), rebelled (B), sinned (R)
decisions.reason: The verb follows the wording settled for the Twelve. "In that day" follows the Isaiah table. |

decisions.choice: *pashaʿ* "transgresser" (L), "se révolter" (B), "pécher" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for *peshaʿ* and its verb in the Twelve.

decisions.choice: "te rebelaste" (L, B); "pecaste" (R)
decisions.reason: Pasha' is "transgredir" at L in the term sheet, but here Spanish L uses "rebelarse", since "transgredir contra" is not good Spanish; R says "pecar".

decisions.choice: feminine "avergonzada", "altiva"
decisions.reason: Zion is addressed as a woman, with feminine agreement, as the term sheet sets.

decisions.choice: "uliniasi" (L, B); "ulipofanya dhambi dhidi yangu" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb pasha' is "kuasi" at L and B and "kutenda dhambi" at R, as the term sheet. At R the English has no span on "me" here, and "dhidi yangu" follows it.

decisions.choice: God now speaks to the city as "con" (B, R), "ngươi" (L), through the promises of 3:11-20
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the city is addressed with promise; the terms note gives "con" at Balanced and Readable for Zion in Zephaniah 3:14-20 and in promises, and "ngươi" at Literal.

decisions.choice: "vi phạm" (L) / "phản nghịch" (B) / "phạm tội" (R) for pasha'
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for the verb in the Twelve.

decisions.choice: *pasha'* is "반역하다" (L, B) and "죄를 짓다" (R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for the verb (Isaiah 53:5 L).

source.text: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֣י בְקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י וָדָ֑ל וְחָס֖וּ בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will leave in your midst a people humble and lowly, and they will take refuge in [the] name of Yahweh.

en.L: And I will leave in your midst \q a people humble and lowly, \q and they will take refuge in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: I will leave within you \q a people humble and lowly, \q who will take refuge in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But I will leave among you \q people who are humble and poor. \q They will trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to keep them safe.

fr.L: Et je laisserai au milieu de toi \q un peuple humble et pauvre, \q et ils se réfugieront dans le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Je laisserai au milieu de toi \q un peuple humble et pauvre, \q qui cherchera refuge dans le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais je laisserai au milieu de toi \q des gens humbles et pauvres. \q Ils compteront sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} pour les protéger.

es.L: Y dejaré en medio de ti \q un pueblo humilde y pobre, \q y se refugiarán en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Dejaré en medio de ti \q un pueblo humilde y pobre, \q que se refugiará en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero dejaré en medio de ti \q gente humilde y pobre. \q Ellos confiarán en que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los protegerá.

sw.L: Nami nitaacha katikati yako \q watu wanyenyekevu na maskini, \q nao watakimbilia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Nitaacha ndani yako \q watu wanyenyekevu na maskini, \q watakaokimbilia jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini nitaacha kati yako \q watu walio wanyenyekevu na maskini. \q Watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awalinde salama.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để lại giữa ngươi \q một dân khiêm nhường và nghèo khó, \q và họ sẽ nương náu nơi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Ta sẽ để lại giữa con \q một dân khiêm nhường và nghèo khó, \q là những người nương náu nơi danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để lại giữa con \q những người khiêm nhường và nghèo khó. \q Họ sẽ tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để được che chở an toàn.

ko.L: 내가 네 가운데 \q 겸손하고 가난한 백성을 남겨 두겠다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름에 피할 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 네 안에 \q 겸손하고 가난한 백성을 남겨 두겠다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 피난처로 삼을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 내가 너희 가운데 \q 겸손하고 가난한 사람들을 남겨 두겠다. \q 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 자기들을 지켜 줄 것을 믿을 것이다.

decisions.choice: humble and lowly: poor and powerless, and so dependent on God
decisions.reason: The first word means afflicted or poor, the second weak or lowly. Both describe the powerless, and here also those who are humble before God, the people called to seek humility in 2:3. They take the place of the proud of verse 11. |

decisions.choice: take refuge in the name of the LORD: trust in the LORD himself for protection
decisions.reason: The name stands for the LORD himself as he has made himself known. "The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run into it and are safe" (Proverbs 18:10; compare Psalm 5:12). |

decisions.choice: trust in the LORD to keep them safe (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says what taking refuge means (m2). |

source.text: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־יַעֲשׂ֤וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְלֹא־יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב וְלֹֽא־יִמָּצֵ֥א בְּפִיהֶ֖ם לְשׁ֣וֹן תַּרְמִ֑ית כִּֽי־הֵ֛מָּה יִרְע֥וּ וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] remnant of Israel will not do injustice and will not speak a lie, and there will not be found in their mouth a tongue of deceit; for they will graze and lie down, and there [will be] none making [them] afraid.

en.L: The remnant of Israel will not do injustice and will not speak lies, \q nor will there be found in their mouth a deceitful tongue; \q for they will graze and lie down, and none will make [them] afraid.
en.B: The remnant of Israel will do no wrong and tell no lies; \q no deceitful tongue will be found in their mouths. \q They will graze and lie down, with no one to make them afraid.
en.R: The people of Israel who are left will not do wrong or tell lies. \q They will never try to deceive anyone. \q They will be like sheep that eat and rest, and no one will frighten them.

fr.L: Le reste d’Israël ne commettra pas d’injustice et ne dira pas de mensonges, \q et on ne trouvera pas dans leur bouche de langue trompeuse ; \q car ils paîtront et se coucheront, et personne ne [les] fera trembler.
fr.B: Le reste d’Israël ne fera rien de mal et ne dira pas de mensonges ; \q on ne trouvera pas de langue trompeuse dans leur bouche. \q Ils paîtront et se reposeront, sans personne pour les effrayer.
fr.R: Les Israélites qui resteront ne feront pas le mal et ne diront pas de mensonges. \q Ils n’essaieront jamais de tromper personne. \q Ils seront comme des moutons qui mangent et se reposent, et personne ne leur fera peur.

es.L: El remanente de Israel no hará injusticia ni hablará mentiras, \q ni se hallará en su boca lengua engañosa; \q porque pacerán y se echarán, y no habrá quien [los] espante.
es.B: El remanente de Israel no hará nada malo ni dirá mentiras; \q no se hallará en su boca lengua engañosa. \q Pacerán y se echarán, sin que nadie los espante.
es.R: Los israelitas que queden no harán nada malo ni dirán mentiras. \q Nunca tratarán de engañar a nadie. \q Serán como ovejas que comen y descansan, y nadie las asustará.

sw.L: Mabaki ya Israeli hawatatenda udhalimu wala hawatasema uongo, \q wala ulimi wa hila hautaonekana kinywani mwao; \q kwa maana watakula malisho na kulala, wala hakuna atakayewatia hofu.
sw.B: Mabaki ya Israeli hawatatenda ubaya wala kusema uongo; \q ulimi wa udanganyifu hautaonekana vinywani mwao. \q Watakula malisho na kulala, bila mtu wa kuwatia hofu.
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli watakaobaki hawatatenda mabaya wala kusema uongo. \q Hawatajaribu kamwe kumdanganya mtu yeyote. \q Watakuwa kama kondoo wanaokula na kupumzika, wala hakuna atakayewatisha.

vi.L: Những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ không làm điều bất công và sẽ không nói dối, \q trong miệng họ sẽ không tìm thấy lưỡi gian dối; \q vì họ sẽ được chăn nuôi và nằm nghỉ, và không ai làm [họ] sợ hãi.
vi.B: Những người sót lại của Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ không làm điều sai trái, không nói dối; \q trong miệng họ sẽ không có lưỡi gian dối. \q Họ sẽ ăn cỏ và nằm nghỉ, chẳng ai làm họ sợ hãi.
vi.R: Những người Y-sơ-ra-ên còn sống sót sẽ không làm điều sai trái hay nói dối. \q Họ sẽ không bao giờ tìm cách lừa gạt ai. \q Họ sẽ như đàn chiên được ăn và nghỉ ngơi, và không ai làm họ sợ hãi.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 남은 자는 불의를 행하지 않고 거짓을 말하지 않으며, \q 그들의 입에서 속이는 혀가 발견되지 않을 것이다. \q 그들이 [풀을] 뜯고 누울 것이니, 아무도 [그들을] 두렵게 하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 남은 사람들은 잘못을 행하지 않고 거짓말을 하지 않을 것이다. \q 그들의 입에서 속이는 혀를 찾아볼 수 없을 것이다. \q 그들은 풀을 뜯고 편히 누울 것이고, 아무도 그들을 두렵게 하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 살아남은 사람들은 나쁜 일을 하지 않고 거짓말도 하지 않을 것이다. \q 그들은 결코 남을 속이려 하지 않을 것이다. \q 그들은 풀을 먹고 쉬는 양처럼 살 것이고, 아무도 그들을 겁주지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: will not do injustice: they will be like the LORD
decisions.reason: Verse 5 says that the LORD "does no injustice"; now his people share his character. Revelation 14:5 says of the redeemed that "no lie was found in their mouth". |

decisions.choice: they will graze and lie down, and none will make them afraid: they will live in peace like a well-kept flock
decisions.reason: The remnant is pictured as sheep at pasture. "No one will make them afraid" is a promise of the covenant (Leviticus 26:6; Micah 4:4; Ezekiel 34:28). |

decisions.choice: the remnant of Israel: the people of verse 12
decisions.reason: Zephaniah uses "Israel" for the whole people of God, of whom Judah is what remains. See the note on the remnant at 2:7. |

decisions.choice: like sheep that eat and rest (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison so that it is not read as about real grazing. |

decisions.choice: "el remanente" (L, B); "los que queden" (R)
decisions.reason: The remnant follows the Spanish prophets at each level.

source.text: רָנִּי֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְעָלְזִי֙ בְּכָל־לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Shout for joy, daughter of Zion; shout, Israel; be glad and exult with all [the] heart, daughter of Jerusalem.

en.L: Shout for joy, daughter of Zion; \q shout aloud, Israel! \q Be glad and exult with all [your] heart, \q daughter of Jerusalem!
en.B: Sing for joy, Daughter Zion; \q shout aloud, Israel! \q Be glad and rejoice with all your heart, \q Daughter Jerusalem!
en.R: Sing for joy, people of Zion! \q Shout, people of Israel! \q Be glad and celebrate with all your heart, \q people of Jerusalem!

fr.L: Pousse des cris de joie, fille de Sion ; \q crie fort, Israël ! \q Réjouis-toi et exulte de tout [ton] cœur, \q fille de Jérusalem !
fr.B: Chante de joie, fille de Sion ; \q pousse des acclamations, Israël ! \q Sois dans l’allégresse et réjouis-toi de tout ton cœur, \q fille de Jérusalem !
fr.R: Chante de joie, peuple de Sion ! \q Crie fort, peuple d’Israël ! \q Sois heureux et fais la fête de tout ton cœur, \q peuple de Jérusalem !

es.L: ¡Grita de júbilo, hija de Sion; \q da voces, Israel! \q ¡Alégrate y regocíjate de todo corazón, \q hija de Jerusalén!
es.B: ¡Canta de alegría, hija de Sion; \q grita con fuerza, Israel! \q ¡Alégrate y regocíjate de todo corazón, \q hija de Jerusalén!
es.R: ¡Canta de alegría, pueblo de Sion! \q ¡Grita, pueblo de Israel! \q ¡Alégrate y celebra con todo tu corazón, \q gente de Jerusalén!

sw.L: Piga kelele kwa furaha, binti Sayuni; \q piga kelele kwa sauti, Israeli! \q Furahi na kushangilia kwa moyo [wako] wote, \q binti Yerusalemu!
sw.B: Imba kwa furaha, Binti Sayuni; \q piga kelele kwa sauti, Israeli! \q Furahi na kushangilia kwa moyo wako wote, \q Binti Yerusalemu!
sw.R: Imbeni kwa furaha, enyi watu wa Sayuni! \q Pigeni kelele, enyi watu wa Israeli! \q Furahini na kusherehekea kwa moyo wenu wote, \q enyi watu wa Yerusalemu!

vi.L: Hãy reo vui, hỡi con gái Si-ôn; \q hãy hò reo, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Hãy vui mừng và hớn hở hết [lòng], \q hỡi con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem!
vi.B: Hãy hát mừng, hỡi con gái Si-ôn; \q hãy reo hò lớn tiếng, hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên! \q Hãy hết lòng vui mừng và hân hoan, \q hỡi con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem!
vi.R: Hỡi dân Si-ôn, hãy hát mừng! \q Hỡi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy reo hò! \q Hỡi dân Giê-ru-sa-lem, \q hãy hết lòng vui mừng và ăn mừng!

ko.L: 딸 시온아, 기뻐 외쳐라. \q 이스라엘아, 환호하여라! \q 온 마음으로 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라, \q 딸 예루살렘아!
ko.B: 딸 시온아, 기뻐 노래하여라. \q 이스라엘아, 큰 소리로 외쳐라! \q 온 마음으로 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라, \q 딸 예루살렘아!
ko.R: 시온 백성아, 기뻐 노래하여라! \q 이스라엘 백성아, 소리쳐라! \q 온 마음으로 기뻐하고 즐거워하여라, \q 예루살렘 백성아!

decisions.choice: daughter of Zion, daughter of Jerusalem: the city and its people, pictured as a young woman
decisions.reason: "Daughter Zion" is a name for Jerusalem and its people together (Isaiah 1:8; 62:11). The city condemned in verse 1 is now the one told to rejoice. |

decisions.choice: four calls to rejoice: the judgment is over
decisions.reason: The verse heaps up words for joy: shout, raise a shout, be glad, exult. The reason follows in verse 15. Zechariah 9:9 begins with a call like this. |

decisions.choice: daughter of Zion (L), Daughter Zion (B), people of Zion (R)
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the Isaiah table; "daughter of Jerusalem" follows it the same way. |

decisions.choice: "fille de Sion", "fille de Jérusalem" (L, B); "peuple de Sion", "peuple de Jérusalem" (R)
decisions.reason: The French prophets' settled wording for daughter Zion; Readable names the people, as the English Readable, and Zion is addressed as "tu" through verse 19.

decisions.choice: "hija de Sion", "hija de Jerusalén" (L, B); "pueblo de Sion", "gente de Jerusalén" (R)
decisions.reason: Daughter Zion follows the Spanish of Isaiah and Lamentations; the singular "tú" is kept, since Zion is addressed as one woman.

decisions.choice: "de todo corazón"
decisions.reason: Spanish says "de todo corazón" without a possessive, so L needs no bracket.

decisions.choice: "binti Sayuni" (L); "Binti Sayuni" (B); "watu wa Sayuni" (R), and likewise Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Daughter Zion as the Isaiah block and 2 Kings 19:21 set it.

decisions.choice: "con gái Si-ôn", "con gái Giê-ru-sa-lem" (L, B) / "dân Si-ôn", "dân Giê-ru-sa-lem" (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah terms note's wording for daughter Zion.

decisions.choice: Daughter Zion is "딸 시온" (L, B) and "시온 백성" (R); Daughter Jerusalem likewise "딸 예루살렘" and "예루살렘 백성"
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as Isaiah and 2 Kings 19:21. From 3:14 to 3:17 the prophet speaks to the city and of God, so God takes -시- (3:15, 17).

source.text: הֵסִ֤יר יְהוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל׀יְהוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ לֹא־תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh has removed your judgments; he has turned away your enemy. [The] king of Israel, Yahweh, [is] in your midst; you will not fear evil again.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has taken away your judgments; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has cleared away your enemy. \q The King of Israel, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, is in your midst; \q you will not fear evil again.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has taken away the judgments against you; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has turned back your enemy. \q The King of Israel, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, is with you; \q you will never again fear disaster.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} has stopped punishing you. \q He has sent your enemies away. \q {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}}, the King of Israel, is with you. \q You will never again be afraid of harm.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ôté tes jugements ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a écarté ton ennemi. \q Le Roi d’Israël, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, est au milieu de toi ; \q tu ne craindras plus le malheur.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a levé les sentences portées contre toi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a repoussé ton ennemi. \q Le Roi d’Israël, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, est avec toi ; \q tu ne craindras plus jamais le malheur.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a cessé de te punir. \q Il a chassé tes ennemis. \q {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Roi d’Israël, est avec toi. \q Tu n’auras plus jamais peur du malheur.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha quitado tus juicios; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha echado fuera a tu enemigo. \q El Rey de Israel, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [está] en medio de ti; \q no temerás más el mal.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha quitado los juicios contra ti; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho retroceder a tu enemigo. \q El Rey de Israel, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, está contigo; \q nunca más temerás la desgracia.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha dejado de castigarte. \q Ha alejado a tus enemigos. \q {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Rey de Israel, está contigo. \q Nunca más tendrás miedo de ningún mal.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameziondoa hukumu zako; \q amemfukuzia mbali adui yako. \q Mfalme wa Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yuko katikati yako; \q hutaogopa mabaya tena.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameziondoa hukumu zilizokuwa juu yako; \q amemrudisha nyuma adui yako. \q Mfalme wa Israeli, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yuko pamoja nawe; \q hutaogopa maafa tena kamwe.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameacha kukuadhibu. \q Amewafukuza adui zako. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mfalme wa Israeli, yuko pamoja nawe. \q Hutaogopa madhara tena kamwe.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cất bỏ những án phạt của ngươi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã dẹp sạch kẻ thù của ngươi. \q Vua của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ở giữa ngươi; \q ngươi sẽ không còn sợ tai họa nữa.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã cất bỏ những án phạt nghịch cùng con; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đẩy lui kẻ thù của con. \q Vua của Y-sơ-ra-ên, là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ở cùng con; \q con sẽ chẳng bao giờ còn sợ tai họa nữa.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã thôi trừng phạt con. \q Ngài đã đuổi kẻ thù của con đi. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Vua của Y-sơ-ra-ên, ở cùng con. \q Con sẽ không bao giờ còn sợ điều gì làm hại con nữa.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에 대한 심판들을 거두시고, \q 너의 원수를 쫓아내셨다. \q 이스라엘의 왕 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네 가운데 계시니, \q 네가 다시는 재앙을 두려워하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 내리신 심판을 거두시고, \q 너의 원수를 물리치셨다. \q 이스라엘의 왕이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계시니, \q 너는 다시는 재앙을 두려워하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 벌하시는 것을 멈추셨다. \q 그분께서 네 원수들을 쫓아 버리셨다. \q 이스라엘의 왕이신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계신다. \q 너는 다시는 해를 당할까 두려워하지 않을 것이다.

decisions.choice: your judgments: the sentences passed against you
decisions.reason: The judgments are the punishments the LORD decreed on the city (verses 6-8). He himself has taken them away. |

decisions.choice: the King of Israel, the LORD, in your midst
decisions.reason: The LORD reigns as Israel's King (Isaiah 33:22; 44:6). He was "in her midst" as judge (verse 5); now he is in her midst to save (verse 17). |

decisions.choice: evil: harm, disaster
decisions.reason: The word covers both wrongdoing and misfortune. Here it is the harm that enemies do. |

decisions.choice: the King of Israel, with a capital K
decisions.reason: "King" is capitalized as a title of God, as in Jeremiah 46:18. Readable says "stopped punishing you" for "taken away your judgments" (m1). |

decisions.choice: "Vua của Y-sơ-ra-ên", capitalised
decisions.reason: The LORD himself is the King, as the English capital shows.

source.text: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִירֽוּשָׁלִַ֖ם אַל־תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל־יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: In that day it will be said to Jerusalem, Do not fear, Zion; let not your hands drop.

en.L: In that day \q it will be said to Jerusalem, "Do not fear; \q Zion, let not your hands drop."
en.B: On that day \q they will say to Jerusalem, "Do not be afraid; \q Zion, do not let your hands hang limp."
en.R: At that time \q people will say to Jerusalem, "Do not be afraid! \q Zion, do not lose heart."

fr.L: En ce jour-là \q on dira à Jérusalem : « Ne crains pas ; \q Sion, que tes mains ne faiblissent pas. »
fr.B: Ce jour-là, \q on dira à Jérusalem : « N’aie pas peur ; \q Sion, ne laisse pas tes mains retomber. »
fr.R: En ce temps-là, \q on dira à Jérusalem : « N’aie pas peur ! \q Sion, ne perds pas courage. »

es.L: En aquel día \q se dirá a Jerusalén: «No temas; \q Sion, no se debiliten tus manos».
es.B: Aquel día \q le dirán a Jerusalén: «No tengas miedo; \q Sion, no dejes caer los brazos».
es.R: En ese tiempo \q la gente le dirá a Jerusalén: «¡No tengas miedo! \q Sion, no te desanimes».

sw.L: Katika siku ile \q Yerusalemu utaambiwa, "Usiogope; \q Sayuni, mikono yako isilegee."
sw.B: Siku hiyo \q watauambia Yerusalemu, "Usiogope; \q Sayuni, mikono yako isilegee."
sw.R: Wakati huo \q watu wataiambia Yerusalemu, "Usiogope! \q Sayuni, usikate tamaa."

vi.L: Trong ngày ấy \q người ta sẽ nói với Giê-ru-sa-lem: "Đừng sợ; \q hỡi Si-ôn, đừng để tay ngươi rũ xuống."
vi.B: Vào ngày ấy \q người ta sẽ nói với Giê-ru-sa-lem: "Đừng sợ; \q hỡi Si-ôn, đừng để tay mình buông thõng."
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy \q người ta sẽ nói với Giê-ru-sa-lem: "Đừng sợ! \q Hỡi Si-ôn, đừng ngã lòng."

ko.L: 그날에 \q 예루살렘에게 이런 말을 할 것이다. "두려워하지 마라. \q 시온아, 네 손을 늘어뜨리지 마라."
ko.B: 그날에 \q 사람들이 예루살렘에게 말할 것이다. "두려워하지 마라. \q 시온아, 네 손에 힘을 잃지 마라."
ko.R: 그때에 \q 사람들이 예루살렘에게 말할 것이다. "두려워하지 마라! \q 시온아, 용기를 잃지 마라."

decisions.choice: let not your hands drop: do not lose courage
decisions.reason: Hands that drop are a sign of fear and helplessness (Isaiah 13:7; Jeremiah 6:24); strengthening weak hands means giving courage (Isaiah 35:3). |

decisions.choice: Do not fear, Zion: words taken up in John 12:15
decisions.reason: When Jesus enters Jerusalem on a donkey, John 12:15 quotes Zechariah 9:9 but begins "Do not be afraid, daughter of Zion", words close to this verse and Isaiah 40:9. |

decisions.choice: let not your hands drop (L), hang limp (B), lose heart (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture, Balanced makes it natural English, and Readable says what it means (m1). The words spoken to Jerusalem are in double quotes. |

decisions.choice: "Ne crains pas" (L), as John 12:15
decisions.reason: John 12:15 takes up these words; Literal keeps the published John's "Ne crains pas", while Balanced and Readable use the everyday "N'aie pas peur".

decisions.choice: "No temas"
decisions.reason: John 12:15 takes up these words; L keeps "No temas", the Spanish of John 12:15, so the echo can be seen.

decisions.choice: "Usiogope" (as John 12:15); "mikono yako isilegee" (L, B), "usikate tamaa" (R)
decisions.reason: John 12:15 takes up "Do not fear, Zion", and the published Swahili John has "Usiogope", which is kept. The idiom of slack hands is kept at L and B, as Isaiah 35:3 "mikono iliyolegea"; Readable says what it means.

decisions.choice: "Đừng sợ" ... "hỡi Si-ôn"
decisions.reason: The allusion decision: John 12:15 takes up these words; the Vietnamese shares its "Đừng sợ" and "Si-ôn".

decisions.choice: "Do not fear" is "두려워하지 마라" at every level, the verb of the Korean John 12:15 L
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that John 12:15 takes up these words; the Korean keeps the shared verb so the echo can be seen, though John's line is otherwise from Zechariah 9:9.

source.text: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךגִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִךְ בְּשִׂמְחָ֗ה יַחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּאַ֣הֲבָת֔וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִךְ בְּרִנָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Yahweh your God [is] in your midst, a warrior who saves; he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will be silent in his love; he will exult over you with a shout of joy.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is in your midst, a warrior who saves; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rejoice over you with gladness, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be silent in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will exult over you with a shout of joy.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is in your midst, a mighty warrior who saves; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will delight in you with gladness and be quiet in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will rejoice over you with singing.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} your God is with you, a mighty warrior who will save you; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will be very happy with you and rest quietly in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} love for you; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sing and shout for joy over you.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est au milieu de toi, un guerrier qui sauve ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} réjouira à ton sujet avec allégresse, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} taira dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} exultera à ton sujet avec des cris de joie.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est au milieu de toi, un vaillant guerrier qui sauve ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fera de toi {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} joie et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} allégresse, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} reposera en silence dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} réjouira à ton sujet par des chants.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu est avec toi, un vaillant guerrier qui te sauvera ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sera très heureux à cause de toi et {{deity_pronoun:se|Se}} reposera en paix dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour pour toi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} chantera et criera de joie à cause de toi.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios [está] en medio de ti, un guerrero que salva; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se gozará por ti con alegría, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} callará en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se regocijará por ti con gritos de júbilo.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios está en medio de ti, un guerrero poderoso que salva; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se deleitará en ti con alegría y descansará en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se alegrará por ti con cantos.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios está contigo, un guerrero poderoso que te salvará; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estará muy feliz contigo y descansará tranquilo en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor por ti; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cantará y gritará de alegría por ti.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako yuko katikati yako, shujaa anayeokoa; \q atakufurahia kwa furaha, atanyamaza katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q atakushangilia kwa kelele za furaha.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako yuko katikati yako, shujaa mwenye nguvu anayeokoa; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atapendezwa nawe kwa furaha na kutulia katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; \q atakushangilia kwa nyimbo.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako yuko pamoja nawe, shujaa mwenye nguvu atakayekuokoa. \q Yeye atafurahi sana juu yako na kutulia kimya katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwako. \q Ataimba na kupiga kelele kwa furaha juu yako.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ngươi ở giữa ngươi, một chiến binh giải cứu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui mừng vì ngươi cách hân hoan, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ lặng im trong tình yêu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ hớn hở vì ngươi với tiếng reo vui.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con ở giữa con, là chiến binh dũng mãnh giải cứu; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui thích về con cách hân hoan, và lặng yên trong tình yêu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui mừng về con bằng tiếng hát.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của con ở cùng con, là chiến binh dũng mãnh sẽ giải cứu con. \q Ngài sẽ rất vui lòng về con và yên nghỉ trong tình yêu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dành cho con. \q Ngài sẽ ca hát và reo mừng vì con.

ko.L: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 네 가운데 계신다. 구원하시는 용사이시다. \q 그분께서 기쁨으로 너를 두고 즐거워하시고, 그분의 사랑 안에서 잠잠하시며, \q 기뻐 외치며 너를 두고 기뻐하실 것이다.
ko.B: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계신다. 그분은 구원하시는 용사이시다. \q 그분께서 너를 크게 기뻐하시고, 사랑으로 너를 잠잠히 품으시며, \q 노래하며 너를 기뻐하실 것이다.
ko.R: 네 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너와 함께 계신다. 그분은 너를 구원하실 힘센 용사이시다. \q 그분께서는 너 때문에 몹시 기뻐하시고, 너를 사랑하셔서 조용히 쉬실 것이다. \q 그분께서 너 때문에 노래하시며 기뻐 외치실 것이다.

decisions.choice: a warrior who saves: a mighty one who gives victory
decisions.reason: The warrior who cried out bitterly on the day of the LORD (1:14) could not save himself. Here the LORD himself is the warrior, and he saves his people (Isaiah 42:13; Psalm 24:8). |

decisions.choice: he will be silent in his love: his love is quiet and at rest
alternatives: he will renew you in his love
he will quiet you with his love
decisions.reason: The verb means "be silent". It may mean that the LORD's love is too deep for words, or that he rests content in it, or that he will no longer speak of the city's sins. Others read it "he will quiet you by his love". The Greek translation is generally said to read "he will renew you", which in Hebrew differs by one letter. The silence stands between two lines of loud joy.

decisions.choice: the LORD rejoices over his people with shouts of joy
decisions.reason: In verse 14 the people are told to shout for joy; here the LORD himself sings over them. Isaiah 62:5 and 65:19 also speak of God rejoicing over Jerusalem as a groom over his bride. |

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans for every "he" and "his"
decisions.reason: Every pronoun for the LORD in this verse takes the deity_pronoun setting, as set for Zephaniah 3:17. Each clause is joined to the one before, so that no pronoun stands first in a sentence. Balanced says "rejoice over you with singing" for the shout of joy. |

decisions.choice: "él" written out with deity_pronoun spans throughout
decisions.reason: The term sheet asks for deity_pronoun spans throughout this verse; Spanish writes the subject "él" each time so that each carries the setting. The lines are drafted from the gloss, away from familiar versions.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on the free pronouns "yeye" and "wake" only
decisions.reason: The English puts spans on every "he" and "his" here; Swahili carries most of them in verb prefixes ("atakufurahia", "atanyamaza"), which take no capital, so only the free pronoun and the possessive "upendo wake" take spans. A pronoun at the start of a sentence is written with its capital.

decisions.choice: "atanyamaza katika upendo wake" (L); "kutulia katika upendo wake" (B); "kutulia kimya katika upendo wake" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says God will be silent in his love; the levels keep that quiet rest, as the English does, and the meaning decision's footnote gives the other reading.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on every "Ngài" in mid-sentence; a line that begins a new sentence has "Ngài" plainly
decisions.reason: The English terms note asks for spans throughout this verse; Vietnamese spans every mid-sentence pronoun and writes a sentence-initial one with its capital, as the style guide requires.

decisions.choice: "he will rejoice over you with singing" is "노래하며 너를 기뻐하실 것이다" (B), with -시- at every level; Korean has no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. The English sets every "he" here as a deity span; Korean shows the same respect through -시-, "께서" and "그분", which have nothing for the setting to change.

decisions.choice: "he will be silent in his love" is "그분의 사랑 안에서 잠잠하시며" (L), "사랑으로 너를 잠잠히 품으시며" (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is hard and the meaning decision footnotes the alternatives; Literal keeps the Hebrew's silence, and Balanced says the quiet love in natural Korean.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans on every "il" and possessive for the LORD
decisions.reason: As the English, which marks every pronoun in this verse; French spans each "il", "son" and "sa".

source.text: נוּגֵ֧י מִמּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [Those] grieving from [the] appointed feast I have gathered; from you they were, a burden on her, a reproach.

en.L: Those who grieve over the appointed feast I will gather; \q they were from you, a burden on her, a reproach.
en.B: I will gather those who grieve because they are kept from the appointed feasts; \q they are your own, and the disgrace has been a burden on them.
en.R: I will gather those who are sad because they cannot come to the festivals. \q They are your own people, and they have carried the burden of shame.

fr.L: Ceux qui s’affligent loin de la fête fixée, je les rassemblerai ; \q ils étaient de toi, un fardeau sur elle, un opprobre.
fr.B: Je rassemblerai ceux qui s’affligent d’être privés des fêtes fixées ; \q ils sont des tiens, et l’opprobre a pesé sur eux comme un fardeau.
fr.R: Je rassemblerai ceux qui sont tristes parce qu’ils ne peuvent pas venir aux fêtes. \q Ce sont des gens de ton peuple, et ils ont porté le poids de la honte.

es.L: A los que se afligen por la fiesta señalada los reuniré; \q de ti eran, una carga sobre ella, un oprobio.
es.B: Reuniré a los que sufren porque se les impide celebrar las fiestas señaladas; \q son tuyos, y el oprobio ha sido una carga para ellos.
es.R: Reuniré a los que están tristes porque no pueden ir a las fiestas. \q Son de tu propio pueblo, y han cargado con la vergüenza.

sw.L: Wale wanaohuzunika kwa ajili ya sikukuu iliyoamriwa nitawakusanya; \q walikuwa wako, mzigo juu yake, aibu.
sw.B: Nitawakusanya wale wanaohuzunika kwa sababu wamezuiliwa wasihudhurie sikukuu zilizoamriwa; \q wao ni wako, na aibu imekuwa mzigo juu yao.
sw.R: Nitawakusanya wale walio na huzuni kwa sababu hawawezi kuja kwenye sikukuu. \q Wao ni watu wako, nao wamebeba mzigo wa aibu.

vi.L: Những kẻ buồn rầu vì kỳ lễ đã định, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm lại; \q họ vốn từ ngươi mà ra, một gánh nặng trên nàng, một sự sỉ nhục.
vi.B: Ta sẽ nhóm lại những người buồn rầu vì không được dự các kỳ lễ đã định; \q họ là người của con, và sự sỉ nhục đã đè nặng trên họ.
vi.R: Ta sẽ nhóm lại những người buồn bã vì không thể đến dự các kỳ lễ. \q Họ là dân của con, và họ đã phải mang gánh nặng xấu hổ.

ko.L: 정한 절기 때문에 슬퍼하는 자들을 내가 모으겠다. \q 그들은 너에게서 나온 자들이었고, 그에게 짐이 되고 수치가 되었다.
ko.B: 정한 절기를 지키지 못해 슬퍼하는 자들을 내가 모으겠다. \q 그들은 너에게 속한 자들이고, 수치가 그들에게 무거운 짐이 되었다.
ko.R: 절기에 오지 못해 슬퍼하는 사람들을 내가 모으겠다. \q 그들은 바로 너의 백성이다. 그들은 부끄러움을 짐처럼 지고 살았다.

decisions.choice: those who grieve over the appointed feast: those who mourn because they cannot keep the festivals
alternatives: as on the day of a festival
decisions.reason: The Hebrew of this verse is very hard, and the ancient translations read it in different ways. The Greek is generally said to join the first words to verse 17 ("as on a day of festival"). The reading taken here keeps the Hebrew words: the LORD will gather those who grieve because they are cut off from the feasts at Jerusalem, and who have borne its disgrace. "I have gathered" is read as a sure promise of what he will do.

decisions.choice: the appointed feasts: Israel's yearly festivals at the temple
decisions.reason: The appointed feasts were the festivals of Leviticus 23, kept at the sanctuary. When the temple was ruined or the people exiled, they could not be kept, and that was a grief in itself (Lamentations 1:4; 2:6). |

decisions.choice: because they are kept from (B), because they cannot come to (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say why they grieve, the sense taken in m1.

decisions.choice: "a burden on her" is "그에게 짐이" at Literal
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns from "you" to "her" (the city), and the meaning is uncertain (footnoted); Literal keeps the turn with a plain "그" rather than "그녀", per the term sheet's rule for Zion.

source.text: הִנְנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת־כָּל־מְעַנַּ֖יִךְ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת־הַצֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְהַנִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְשֵׁ֔ם בְּכָל־הָאָ֖רֶץ בָּשְׁתָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, I [am] dealing with all who afflict you at that time; and I will save the lame and gather the outcast, and I will make them into praise and a name in all the earth [where] their shame [was].

en.L: Look, I am dealing with all who afflict you at that time; \q and I will save the lame and gather the outcast, \q and I will make them a praise and a name \q in all the earth [where] their shame [was].
en.B: At that time I will deal with all who oppress you. \q I will rescue the lame and gather the scattered; \q I will give them praise and honor \q in every land where they were disgraced.
en.R: At that time I will punish everyone who has been cruel to you. \q I will save {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who are lame and bring home those who were driven away. \q In every land where people laughed at them, \q I will make them praised and honored.

fr.L: Voici, je vais agir contre tous ceux qui t’oppriment, en ce temps-là ; \q et je sauverai la boiteuse et rassemblerai la rejetée, \q et je ferai d’eux une louange et un nom \q dans toute la terre [où était] leur honte.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, j’agirai contre tous ceux qui t’oppriment. \q Je sauverai les boiteux et rassemblerai les dispersés ; \q je leur donnerai louange et renom \q dans tous les pays où ils ont été couverts de honte.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je punirai tous ceux qui ont été cruels envers toi. \q Je sauverai les membres boiteux de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple et je ramènerai chez eux ceux qui avaient été chassés. \q Dans tous les pays où l’on se moquait d’eux, \q je ferai qu’on les loue et qu’on les honore.

es.L: He aquí, yo actuaré contra todos los que te afligen en aquel tiempo; \q y salvaré a la coja y recogeré a la descarriada, \q y los convertiré en alabanza y renombre \q en toda la tierra [donde estaba] su vergüenza.
es.B: En aquel tiempo actuaré contra todos los que te oprimen. \q Rescataré a la coja y reuniré a la dispersa; \q les daré alabanza y honra \q en todas las tierras donde fueron avergonzados.
es.R: En ese tiempo castigaré a todos los que te han tratado con crueldad. \q Salvaré a los de {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo que están cojos y traeré de vuelta a los que fueron expulsados. \q En todas las tierras donde se burlaron de ellos, \q haré que los alaben y los honren.

sw.L: Tazama, ninashughulika na wote wanaokutesa wakati huo; \q nami nitawaokoa walio viwete na kuwakusanya waliofukuzwa, \q nami nitawafanya kuwa sifa na jina \q katika dunia yote [ambako] aibu yao [ilikuwa].
sw.B: Wakati huo nitashughulika na wote wanaokuonea. \q Nitawaokoa walio viwete na kuwakusanya waliotawanyika; \q nitawapa sifa na heshima \q katika kila nchi ambako waliaibishwa.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitamwadhibu kila mtu aliyekutendea ukatili. \q Nitawaokoa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} walio viwete na kuwarudisha nyumbani wale waliofukuzwa. \q Katika kila nchi ambako watu waliwacheka, \q nitawafanya wasifiwe na kuheshimiwa.

vi.L: Kìa, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xử những kẻ làm khổ ngươi vào lúc ấy; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ cứu kẻ què và nhóm người bị đuổi đi, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho họ được khen ngợi và có danh tiếng \q trên khắp đất [là nơi] họ đã chịu hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ xử những kẻ áp bức con. \q Ta sẽ giải cứu kẻ què và nhóm lại những người tản lạc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ban cho họ lời khen ngợi và danh dự \q tại mọi xứ mà họ đã từng bị sỉ nhục.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ trừng phạt mọi kẻ đã tàn ác với con. \q Ta sẽ cứu những người què trong dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và đem về những người đã bị đuổi đi. \q Tại mọi xứ mà người ta đã chế nhạo họ, \q {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho họ được khen ngợi và tôn trọng.

ko.L: 보라, 그때에 내가 너를 괴롭히는 모든 자를 처리하겠다. \q 내가 저는 자를 구원하고 쫓겨난 자를 모으겠다. \q 그들이 수치를 당하던 온 땅에서 \q 그들을 칭찬과 이름이 되게 하겠다.
ko.B: 그때에 내가 너를 억압하는 자들을 모두 벌하겠다. \q 내가 다리를 저는 자들을 구해 내고, 흩어진 자들을 모으겠다. \q 그들이 수치를 당하던 모든 땅에서 \q 그들이 칭찬과 존귀를 얻게 하겠다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 너를 괴롭힌 자들을 모두 벌하겠다. \q 내가 다리를 저는 내 백성을 구하고, 쫓겨난 사람들을 집으로 데려오겠다. \q 사람들이 그들을 비웃던 모든 땅에서 \q 내가 그들을 칭찬받고 존경받게 하겠다.

decisions.choice: the lame and the outcast: the scattered flock gathered home
decisions.reason: The words are feminine and singular, picturing the people as a flock with its weak and strayed sheep. Micah 4:6-7 makes the same promise in nearly the same words, and Ezekiel 34:16 has the shepherd seek the lost and bind up the injured. |

decisions.choice: a praise and a name: renown and honor
decisions.reason: To have a name is to be honored and famous. Deuteronomy 26:19 and Jeremiah 13:11 use the same words for what Israel was meant to be for the LORD; Jeremiah 33:9 promises it again. |

decisions.choice: in all the earth where their shame was: in the lands where they were disgraced
decisions.reason: The last words, "their shame", are joined to "all the earth": the places where they were put to shame will now see them honored. |

decisions.choice: deal with (L, B), punish (R); the scattered (B), driven away (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "punish" for "deal with", which in this setting means to deal with in judgment. Readable makes the sheep picture plain by calling them the LORD's people. |

decisions.choice: "la boiteuse", "la rejetée" (L), feminine as the Hebrew; "les boiteux", "les dispersés" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew participles are feminine singular, the flock pictured as one ewe (as Micah 4:6-7); Literal keeps the form, and the other levels say who is meant.

decisions.choice: feminine "la coja", "la descarriada" / "la dispersa"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew words are feminine singular, the picture of a lame and strayed ewe for the scattered flock (as Micah 4:6-7); L and B keep the feminine, R names the people.

source.text: בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ אָבִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם וּבָעֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֜ם לְשֵׁ֣ם וְלִתְהִלָּ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשׁוּבִ֧י אֶת־שְׁבוּתֵיכֶ֛ם לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: At that time I will bring you [in], and at [the] time of my gathering you; for I will make you a name and a praise among all [the] peoples of the earth, when I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says Yahweh.

en.L: At that time I will bring you [home], \q even at the time when I gather you; \q for I will give you as a name and as a praise among all the peoples of the earth, \q as I restore your fortunes before your eyes, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: At that time I will bring you home, \q at the time when I gather you. \q I will make you honored and praised among all the peoples of the earth \q as I restore your fortunes before your very eyes, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: At that time I will gather you and bring you home. \q I will make all the nations of the earth honor you and praise you. \q You will see {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} make things good for you again, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: En ce temps-là je vous ferai [revenir], \q au temps où je vous rassemblerai ; \q car je ferai de vous un nom et une louange parmi tous les peuples de la terre, \q quand je rétablirai votre sort sous vos yeux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, je vous ramènerai chez vous, \q au temps où je vous rassemblerai. \q Je ferai de vous un peuple honoré et loué parmi tous les peuples de la terre, \q quand je rétablirai votre sort sous vos yeux mêmes, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: En ce temps-là, je vous rassemblerai et je vous ramènerai chez vous. \q Je ferai que toutes les nations de la terre vous honorent et vous louent. \q Vous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} verrez vous rendre de nouveau heureux, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

es.L: En aquel tiempo {{plural_you:los|os}} traeré [de vuelta], \q en el tiempo en que {{plural_you:los|os}} reúna; \q porque {{plural_you:los|os}} pondré por nombre y por alabanza entre todos los pueblos de la tierra, \q cuando restaure {{plural_you:su suerte|vuestra suerte}} ante {{plural_you:sus ojos|vuestros ojos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: En aquel tiempo {{plural_you:los|os}} traeré de vuelta, \q en el tiempo en que {{plural_you:los|os}} reúna. \q Haré que {{plural_you:sean honrados|seáis honrados}} y alabados entre todos los pueblos de la tierra \q cuando restaure {{plural_you:su suerte|vuestra suerte}} ante {{plural_you:sus propios ojos|vuestros propios ojos}}, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En ese tiempo {{plural_you:los|os}} reuniré y {{plural_you:los|os}} traeré de vuelta a casa. \q Haré que todas las naciones de la tierra {{plural_you:los|os}} honren y {{plural_you:los|os}} alaben. \q {{plural_you:Ustedes verán|Vosotros veréis}} cómo hago que todo vuelva a {{plural_you:irles|iros}} bien, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Wakati huo nitawaleta [nyumbani], \q naam, wakati nitakapowakusanya; \q kwa maana nitawafanya kuwa jina na sifa kati ya watu wote wa dunia, \q nitakapowarudishia mafanikio yenu mbele ya macho yenu, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Wakati huo nitawaleta nyumbani, \q wakati nitakapowakusanya. \q Nitawafanya mheshimiwe na kusifiwa kati ya watu wote wa dunia \q nitakapowarudishia mafanikio yenu mbele ya macho yenu wenyewe, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Wakati huo nitawakusanya na kuwaleta nyumbani. \q Nitayafanya mataifa yote ya dunia yawaheshimu na kuwasifu. \q Mtaniona nikiyafanya mambo yenu kuwa mema tena, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem các ngươi [về], \q phải, vào lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nhóm các ngươi lại; \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho các ngươi có danh tiếng và được khen ngợi giữa mọi dân trên đất, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phục hồi cơ đồ của các ngươi trước mắt các ngươi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.B: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem các con về, \q vào lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nhóm các con lại. \q Ta sẽ làm cho các con được tôn trọng và khen ngợi giữa mọi dân trên đất, \q khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} phục hồi cơ đồ của các con ngay trước mắt các con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Vào lúc ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ nhóm các con lại và đem các con về nhà. \q Ta sẽ làm cho mọi dân tộc trên đất tôn trọng và khen ngợi các con. \q Các con sẽ thấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho mọi sự tốt đẹp trở lại cho các con, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그때에 내가 너희를 [집으로] 데려오겠다. \q 곧 내가 너희를 모으는 때에. \q 참으로 내가 너희를 땅의 모든 백성 가운데서 이름과 칭찬이 되게 하겠다. \q 내가 너희 눈앞에서 너희의 운명을 돌이킬 때에. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.B: 그때에 내가 너희를 고향으로 데려오겠다. \q 내가 너희를 모으는 바로 그때에. \q 내가 너희를 땅의 모든 백성 가운데서 존귀하게 하고 칭찬받게 하겠다. \q 너희 눈앞에서 내가 너희의 형편을 회복시킬 때에. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그때에 내가 너희를 모아 고향으로 데려오겠다. \q 땅의 모든 민족이 너희를 존경하고 칭찬하게 하겠다. \q 너희는 내가 너희를 다시 잘되게 해 주는 것을 너희 눈으로 볼 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

decisions.choice: at that time I will bring you home: the promise of verse 19 said again, now to the people
decisions.reason: "You" is now plural: the LORD speaks to the people themselves. The repetition of "at that time" makes the promise sure. |

decisions.choice: before your eyes: you will see it yourselves
decisions.reason: Those who are scattered will live to see their own restoration. |

decisions.choice: restore your fortunes: give back what was lost
decisions.reason: As in 2:7, the phrase may mean restoring prosperity or bringing back exiles; here, after "I will gather you", both are meant. |

decisions.choice: restore your fortunes (L, B), make things good for you again (R); says the LORD
decisions.reason: The phrase follows the Jeremiah table. "Says the LORD" closes the book at every level. |

decisions.choice: "vous" (plural) in verse 20, after "tu" for Zion
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" is plural in this verse, the scattered people, so French changes to "vous".

decisions.choice: plural_you throughout
decisions.reason: Here the Hebrew "you" turns plural, to the people, and the verse takes plural_you spans throughout. "Dice el SEÑOR" stands for 'amar YHWH, not ne'um.

decisions.choice: "asema BWANA" (L, B); "anasema BWANA" (R) for 'amar YHWH
decisions.reason: "Says the LORD" closing the book takes the same Swahili as the prophets' formula, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (L) / "các con" (B, R) for the plural "you"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision: the promise is now spoken to the people, in the plural; the tender address of 3:11-19 is kept in the plural form.

decisions.choice: "CHÚA phán" for 'amar YHWH at every level
decisions.reason: This closing formula is "says" ('amar), not ne'um, so it takes no "vậy" at Literal or Balanced.

decisions.choice: *'amar YHWH* at the end is "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다" at every level
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here is "says", not *ne'um*, so Literal does not use the *ne'um* wording; God names himself without -시-.
